hints.content: On a  number line, numbers to the left are less than numbers to the right.
The values of $\green{-3}$, $\goldD{-2.3}$, $\purpleD{-1.7}$,  are to the left of  $\redD{-1.6}$.
The values that make the inequality true are $\green{-3}$, $\goldD{-2.3}$, $\purpleD{-1.7}$.
